prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right one depends on what you need (type of healthcare client, services, budget, goals, compliance needs). I can help find the best fit quickly if you tell me more. A few quick clarifying questions:

- What type of organization are you (hospital system, clinic, physician group, med device company, healthtech startup, pharma, nonprofit)?
- What primary services do you need (brand/creative, digital/SEO, paid media, content, PR, physician/patient recruitment, product launches, regulatory/FDA/HIPAA-compliant campaigns)?
- Who is the target audience (consumers/patients, referring physicians, payers, enterprise customers)?
- What is your approximate budget or monthly retainer range?
- Timeline or any upcoming launch/goal?
- Do you prefer local in-person agency vs. remote/national?

How I recommend evaluating agencies (quick checklist)
- Healthcare experience and relevant case studies (similar clients and measurable results)
- Compliance knowledge (HIPAA, FDA, state regs where applicable)
- Clear KPIs and analytics/reporting approach
- Integrated capabilities you need (strategy, creative, digital, PR)
- References and client retention
- Team seniority and hands-on involvement
- Pricing model, scope clarity, and contract terms

Next steps I can do for you
- If you give the details above I’ll shortlist 3–5 St. Louis agencies that match your needs, with pros/cons, likely fit, and sample questions to ask each.
- Or I can produce a general list of well-regarded local healthcare marketers and what they’re known for.

Which would you prefer?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
